outcome.technical: MEASURED (git show per commit on feat(P169.*/P170.*) commits, hunk -> nearest preceding heading in the old guide): P169 declares PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md on 35 of 44 tasks, P170 on 2 of 3 (P170.1, P170.3); 33 of the 43 landed feat commits of the two phases changed the guide. Sections edited (commits): _evidence_io.py 21, module map fence 12 (mechanical write-map regeneration), drive-phase.py 9, _manifest_merge/merge-manifest/_merge_install 5, run-test-gate.py 4, _deps.py 3, import-evidence.py 3, rest 1-2 each; only 10 of the 33 touched exactly one section. The guide holds 165 ### sections under section 2, 133 of them headed by a scripts/ path; 139 modules under scripts/ (LAYERS places all 139); 2664 public top-level names across them; 769 static + 19 runtime-load edges. SECTION LIST / DERIVABILITY: layer (derivable from LAYERS - DONE as the index column), entry-vs-helper (name - DONE), suite exists (tests/test_<name>.py - DONE), importers (reverse of import_graph static+runtime - DONE), imports (already the map fence, section 1a), public names (derivable by ast but 2664 names do not fit one line per module: needs a per-module block inside each section or a separate per-module generated section - NOT DONE, follow-up), entry usage line (not derivable: argparse/usage text is built at run time, not a source constant; a derived form would need each entry to expose a USAGE constant - NOT DONE, follow-up), tree section 1 (per-file lines with hand comments; file LIST derivable, the comments are not - NOT DONE, follow-up). BUILT: mechanism + one generated index. tools/lints/_deps.py: _fence_drift/_rewrite_fence/_write_fence helpers (map_drift and write_map now go through them, behaviour unchanged, g1-g11 untouched and green), render_index(), index_drift(), index_follower(), write_index(), _INDEX_HEADING, `--render-index`, `--write-map` now rewrites both fences and reports each fence's problem separately; the OTHER_WRITERS row for the writer renamed write_map -> _write_fence (pw1/pw2 went red on it). PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: new section '1b. Module index (generated)' (prose + generated fence, 139 lines); nothing hand-written elsewhere touched. tests/test__deps.py: g1i (shipped guide index current, prints the follower line when stale) and gi1-gi5 (exact render of a fixture with every column different incl. an unplaced module; stale/missing-heading/no-fence/unreadable named; follower; independence of the two fences + write_index keeps every other byte and refuses a fence-less guide). changelog.d/P170.3-yl6.changed.md written; changelog.d/P170.3.changed.md (also in the declared files) NOT created, the caller named the -yl6 path. MUTATIONS (shared tree, restored in the same script, cmp equal afterwards, __pycache__ purged between): entry-kind forced to 'module' -> g1i and gi1 red (315/317); importers dropped -> g1i, gi1, gi2, gi4 red (313/317); index comparison disabled -> block aborted (305/309), so that one only shows the suite goes red, not which index case. TALLIES: tests/test__deps.py 317/317 cases passed; full sweep 195/196 files ok, 19945 cases, exit 1. THE ONE RED IS OUTSIDE MY FILES: tools/prove-gates.py case c1 fails with ['index_drift'] - every derived *_drift lint must have a row in prove-gates' TABLE and this one has none. Per the rules I did not edit tools/prove-gates.py. The row that closes it (anchor occurs exactly once in tools/lints/_deps.py; I watched this mutation turn g1i and gi1 red): ("index_drift", L + "_deps.py", "replace", '"entry" if "-" in name else "module"', '"module"', DEP, "g1i") beside the existing map_drift rows near tools/prove-gates.py:740 and :1601. I also kept the literal line `    if block != expected:` in _fence_drift because the existing prove-gates map_drift row anchors on exactly that text. DEPENDANTS: PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md readers (tests/test__deps.py, test__doctor_trail, etc.) - still correct, only an added section 1b, no existing text changed; the guide's _deps.py section (:1822 area) still true (it names map_drift/--render, both unchanged) but does not yet mention index_drift/--render-index - the new 1b prose carries it, I did not rewrite hand text; tools/lints/_deps.py importers (_manifest_rules, _manifest_vocab, _doctor_policy, test__manifest_io, etc.) - still correct, no name removed or signature changed (write_map keeps its contract, g8-g11 green), only additions plus the private _write_fence; tests/test__deps.py dependants - changed, +83 lines of cases; tools/prove-gates.py (named-by-path dependant of test__deps) - CHANGED: needs the index_drift row above, else sweep stays red; CHANGELOG.md/gate-parity/sweep-costs referencing test__deps - unaffected (new cases join the same suite; .github/sweep-costs.json not re-recorded).
